message: The other night, as we were packing our go-bags, I realized just how much our family group chat has changed. Instead of sharing memes or weekend plans, we were tossing around ideas for essentials to include, like snacks and favorite books. It felt good to work together, even in a serious moment. Plus, it reminded me that being prepared can also mean staying connected and supporting each other. What’s your favorite way to keep your family in the loop when it comes to readiness? 😊
